summary_zh: 对话围绕Starnews报道BTS Jin为LANEIGE“Goodnight Challenge”和睡眠面膜宣传引发小红书高观看量展开。收录帖将粉丝热度关联到LANEIGE品牌、睡眠面膜/眼膜及售罄、销量排名等商品表现，未涉及价格或配送。后续仅补发链接，无互动补充；信息偏宣传转述，情绪正面，传播价值在粉丝带动销售话题。

posts.text:
[Starnews] 260927 “Good night.” BTS Jin’s Sweet "Goodnight" Greeting. Xiaohongshu Hot Trend: “As Expected, He’s the Face of LANEIGE”
BTS Jin captivated fans around the world with his dazzling visuals and sweet voice, showcasing his “Worldwide Handsome” charm.
Amorepacific’s beauty brand LANEIGE released a video of its global ambassador Jin as part of a campaign, titled “Jin’s Goodnight Challenge.”
Jin caught attention by taking on the challenge of saying “Good night” in Korean, Chinese, Japanese, and English. About two days after the video was released on LANEIGE’s official social media channels, it surpassed 13 million views on Xiaohongshu, China’s leading social media and e-commerce platform, becoming a hot trend. On Xiaohongshu, where a search-based algorithm drives content discovery, it is unusual for an advertising video to record such a high number of views, exceeding 10 million. Xiaohongshu users praised Jin’s handsome looks, soft voice, and pronunciation in his goodnight greetings.
Meanwhile, LANEIGE recently unveiled a new Sleeping Mask campaign featuring Jin. Immediately after its release, the Sleeping Mask products swept the top spots in LANEIGE’s official brand store sales rankings. On the same day, the LANEIGE Bouncy & Firm Sleeping Mask ranked No. 1 in beauty by sales volume in Naver’s “Chuseok + Sale” promotion before selling out. Sets of the Water Sleeping Mask and Cica Sleeping Mask that included Jin photo stickers also sold out and were replaced with sets offering mini photo books.
In the U.S. LANEIGE launched Jin’s Bouncy & Firm Hydrogel Eye Patches alongside a campaign video featuring Jin. With stores decorated with large photos of Jin, the “face of LANEIGE” is carrying out major campaigns around the world.
#JIN #JinxLaneige #방탄소년단진 @Laneige_kr @BTS_twt

posts.translation_zh:
[Starnews] 260927 “晚安。” BTS Jin 甜蜜的“晚安”问候。小红书热门趋势：“不愧是 LANEIGE 的门面”
BTS Jin 以耀眼的外貌和甜美的嗓音吸引了全球粉丝，展现了他“Worldwide Handsome”的魅力。
爱茉莉太平洋旗下美妆品牌 LANEIGE 发布了一段全球大使 Jin 的宣传活动视频，标题为“Jin’s Goodnight Challenge”。
Jin 挑战用韩语、中文、日语和英语说“晚安”，引发关注。该视频在 LANEIGE 官方社交媒体频道发布约两天后，在中国领先的社交媒体与电商平台小红书上的观看量突破 1300 万，成为热门趋势。在以搜索算法推动内容发现的小红书上，广告视频获得如此高的观看量、超过 1000 万次并不常见。小红书用户称赞了 Jin 帅气的外貌、温柔的声音，以及他在晚安问候中的发音。
与此同时，LANEIGE 最近公开了由 Jin 出镜的全新 Sleeping Mask 宣传活动。发布后不久，Sleeping Mask 产品便包揽了 LANEIGE 官方品牌店销售排行榜的前几名。同一天，LANEIGE Bouncy & Firm Sleeping Mask 在 Naver “Chuseok + Sale”促销活动中按销量位列美妆类第 1 名，随后售罄。包含 Jin 照片贴纸的 Water Sleeping Mask 和 Cica Sleeping Mask 套装也已售罄，并被替换为附赠迷你写真册的套装。
在美国，LANEIGE 推出了 Jin’s Bouncy & Firm Hydrogel Eye Patches，并同步发布了由 Jin 出镜的宣传视频。随着门店用 Jin 的大型照片装饰，“LANEIGE 的门面”正在全球开展大型宣传活动。
#JIN #JinxLaneige #방탄소년단진 @Laneige_kr @BTS_twt
